title: Atlas DataFlow Governed Predict View
description: Minimum governed predict view schema for Atlas DataFlow. Defines stable view identity, public display metadata, intent metadata, dataset association, and constrained binding references for a published dataset release context. Predict view metadata is presentation and intent metadata only; canonical dataset contracts remain the source of truth for runtime validation, inference input semantics, feature domains, and payload behavior.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this predict view schema structure in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format.

view_id.description: Stable predict view identifier. Lowercase ASCII slug used to identify one governed prediction experience within a dataset. It is not a dataset identifier, route alias, or runtime contract name.

dataset_slug.description: Associated published dataset slug. This binds the view to an existing dataset identity and must not replace, alias, or override registry dataset identity.

_example_note.description: Optional annotation for example or demonstration artifacts only. Omit in production predict view records.

display_metadata.description: Public display metadata for rendering and discovery. It must not carry inference validation rules, feature domains, or input semantics.

title.description: Human-readable predict view title for the public experience.

summary.description: Short public-safe summary of the prediction experience.

description.description: Optional public-safe longer description of the view's purpose.

tags.description: Optional public-safe tags for grouping or discovery. Tags are display metadata only.

intent_metadata.description: Intent metadata describing what the view is for and who it is for. It is not executable business logic.

prediction_goal.description: Public-safe statement of the prediction question or user goal.

audience.description: Intended public audience or usage context for this prediction experience.

usage_notes.description: Optional public-safe explanatory notes. Must not contain executable routing, validation, or business rules.

binding_reference.description: Constrained binding reference tying the view to its dataset and active or compatible release context.

dataset_slug.description: Dataset slug for the binding context. It must match the top-level dataset_slug.

release_binding.description: Release binding for the view. The active mode follows the dataset's active release; the compatible mode pins an explicit compatible release identifier.

mode.description: active uses the dataset active_release context. compatible requires an explicit compatible release_id.

release_id.description: Explicit compatible release identifier. Required when mode is compatible and prohibited when mode is active.

contract_precedence.description: Explicit schema-level contract precedence declaration. These constants prevent predict views from becoming a second contract system.

canonical_contracts_are_source_of_truth.description: Must be true. Runtime validation and input semantics remain owned by canonical dataset contracts.

view_metadata_defines_runtime_validation.description: Must be false. View metadata does not define inference validation rules.

view_metadata_duplicates_contract.description: Must be false. View metadata does not duplicate canonical runtime or public contracts.
